shots.prompt_en: A young man holds his phone at arm's length for a selfie-style shot in a bedroom, looking directly into the front camera with a surprised expression, plain wall and unmade bed visible behind him, natural window light, slight handheld shake, no text, no subtitles, no watermarks
shots.prompt_zh: 一位年轻男性在卧室里手持手机自拍式取景，直视前置摄像头露出惊讶的表情，身后可见简单的墙面和未整理的床铺，自然窗光，轻微手持晃动。

shots.camera_note: handheld arm's-length selfie framing, continuous from shot 1
shots.prompt_en: The same young man continues holding the phone at arm's length in the same bedroom, now nodding with a confident expression and pointing toward the camera lens, same plain wall and unmade bed behind him, same natural window light, slight handheld shake, no text, no subtitles, no watermarks
shots.prompt_zh: 同一位年轻男性继续在同一卧室以相同手持自拍角度取景，此时点头并露出自信的表情，手指向镜头方向，背后同样是简单墙面和未整理床铺，同样的自然窗光，轻微手持晃动。

visual_forms.prompt_en: A young man holds his phone at arm's length for a selfie-style shot in a plain bedroom, speaking directly into the front camera with animated natural expressions, unmade bed and plain wall visible behind him, natural window light, slight handheld shake throughout, no text, no subtitles, no watermarks
visual_forms.prompt_zh: 一位年轻男性在简单卧室里手持手机以自拍角度取景，面对前置摄像头自然生动地说话，身后可见未整理的床铺和简单墙面，自然窗光，全程轻微手持晃动。

slot_template.template_en: A young man holds his phone at arm's length for a selfie-style shot in a bedroom with an {ROOM_DETAIL} visible behind him, starting with a {EXPRESSION_START} under {LIGHT_QUALITY}, then {GESTURE_END} as the shot continues, no text, no subtitles, no watermarks
slot_template.template_zh: 一位年轻男性在卧室里手持手机以自拍角度取景，身后可见{ROOM_DETAIL}，开场是{LIGHT_QUALITY}下的{EXPRESSION_START}，随后画面继续，做出{GESTURE_END}的动作。

invariants.description: Same young man in the same clothing appears in both shots
Same bedroom with the same plain wall and unmade bed appears in both shots
Same natural window light continues across the jump cut

meta.note: 合成样例，用于 100x-video-reverse 的 schema/公理校验测试。target_model=即创（按公理2落最严档 8.0s 上限）。本例为 2 镜版本（跳切场景：单一场景单一人物的自拍口播中间有一次跳切，现实里大量单机位 UGC 确实会这样剪），作为『最小多镜』边界样例，与 example-06 的『真单镜』边界样例互补：本例演示 allOf 的 then 分支（>=2镜必须有非空 invariants，见下方 holds_in_shots=[1,2]），example-06 演示 if 条件不成立时的默认情况（1镜，无需 invariants）。
